foreign_keys.why: §6 ON DELETE CASCADE — a deleted product has no stock

rationale.label: No tenant_id on inventory — tenancy is reached via product_id (§6.2)
rationale.why: A second copy of the tenant boundary could disagree with the product's own tenant, and that disagreement is a cross-tenant leak.

rationale.label: available = quantity - reserved_quantity (§6.1)
rationale.why: The one invariant in the schema that must never be violated — violating it means selling stock that is not physically present.

rationale.label: unit_price is copied at purchase time (§9.2)
rationale.why: The order total is what the customer agreed to; a later price edit must not rewrite history.

rationale.label: UNIQUE (order_id) enforces one delivery per order (§8.1)
rationale.why: Without it two agents could both claim the same order and the buyer would see two agents.

rationale.label: sku is unique per tenant, not globally (§5)
rationale.why: A global constraint would force SKU rewriting across tenants and break barcode scanning for anyone onboarding a second storefront.

rationale.label: email is unique per tenant, not globally (§3)
rationale.why: A seller operating two storefronts is one identity with two tenant memberships, not two accounts.

rationale.label: tenants.domain is unique (§2)
rationale.why: Two tenants sharing a domain means one seller's storefront is reachable under another's identity. A security constraint, not a convenience.

rationale.label: Money is NUMERIC(12,2), never FLOAT (§5)
rationale.why: Binary floating point cannot represent 0.10; summing float prices across an order produces reconciliation errors.

rationale.label: status is independent of payment_status (§7.2)
rationale.why: A COD order reaches `completed` while payment is still `pending`. Collapsing them makes 'is this paid?' unanswerable for COD.

rationale.label: Redis holds the queue, Postgres holds the truth (§8.1)
rationale.why: The queue is transient dispatch state. A Redis flush delays dispatch; it does not erase it.

rationale.label: Branch scoping is a column, not a code path (§4)
rationale.why: Enforcing 'Admin manages a single branch' in application code means every new query has to remember the rule.

rationale.label: Demo is a data tenant, not a bypass (§11)
rationale.why: The moment Demo mode skips isolation checks, it becomes a way to read production tenants.
